preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 6 and 200,000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices with labels between 1 and n.
The edges form a valid tree (connected, acyclic).
It is guaranteed that a valid solution with at least two common vertices exists.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == 2 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines, each containing two integers.
The four chosen vertices x1, y1, x2, y2 are all distinct.

postconditions.expression: x1 not in path(x2, y2) and y1 not in path(x2, y2) and x2 not in path(x1, y1) and y2 not in path(x1, y1)
postconditions.description: Neither endpoint of the first path lies on the second path, and vice versa.
The two paths share at least two common vertices.

postconditions.expression: is_optimal(x1, y1, x2, y2, n, edges)
postconditions.description: The chosen pair of paths maximizes the number of common vertices, and among those, maximizes the sum of their lengths.
